messages:
Anya: Quick cross-team sync — SOC2 auditprep. Need owners for audit-log + KMS evidence to hit a Friday demo/artifacts deadline. Who's owning what?
Rohit: I can own the auditlog ingest gap in staging. PR #4523 is the fix but it needs an eng-sre review and deploy.
Ben: I'll take PR #4523 review today. Quick Q — does our audit event schema include envelope_key currently?
Rohit: schema v3 includes envelope_key, but staging pipeline is stripping it. Looks like key-service sets a redact flag before audit-proxy forwards events. Trace: `key-service:check -> audit-proxy`
Sofia: Auditors asked for a tentative timeline — can we commit to demo + artifact pack by Friday EOD? :eyes:
Anya: Target = demo + artifacts Friday EOD. Owners: Rohit (auditlog ingest fix + deploy), Ben (PR review + smoke tests), Kai (sampling & attest), Anya (compile evidence pack). Call out blockers now.
Kai: I can run sampling but need access to staging KMS audit logs. Rohit can you add `kai@redwood.com` to staging-kms-audit role? Command we usually use: `gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-staging --member=user:kai@redwood.com --role=roles/kms.viewer`
Rohit: Added Kai to staging-kms-audit. Also found a failing unit test in key-service that causes timestamp drift — patching now, will push fix in ~2h.
Ben: Reviewed PR #4523, left two small comments about null-handling and a test -> once addressed I'll merge and trigger CI -> deploy. I'll also add a smoke check: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://staging.api.redwood/audit/health`
compliance-bot: Reminder: control evidence checklist updated — SOC2_AU-8 now requires KMS attestation artifact. See /docs/compliance/soc2/evidence-checklist.md
Anya: Follow-ups: (1) Rohit paste PR numbers + deploy id here, (2) Ben post smoke results inline, (3) Kai confirm sample hashes and number of events. I'll pull artifacts into shared drive after smoke passes. Link: https://gdrive.com/rdw-compliance-demo (doc will be populated).
Rohit: PRs: #4523 (ingest fix), #4530 (timestamp patch). Deploy: deploy-20260317-audit-1. Will paste relevant logs after timestamp fix lands.
Sofia: I'll tell the auditors we expect evidence Friday and update the calendar invite. :thumbsup:
Ben: Smoke check passed after merge — `audit/health` ok, sample event includes envelope_key, and CI added the instrumentation test. Pushed logs snippet to the artifacts folder.
Kai: Sampling done — 500 events pulled, hashes attached in the drive. Verified envelope_key present and redaction flag not set for sampled events.
Anya: Great progress. I'll assemble the evidence pack (logs, PRs, smoke output, attestation) and share by EOD Friday. If anything slips, flag in this thread.
Rohit: Noting a minor follow-up: we'll run a short backfill job to cover 24h prior to demo to avoid sampling gaps — will schedule tonight.
Sofia: Thanks everyone. If blockers pop up, @here call it out.
Anya: Thanks — closing async sync for now.
